text:
Ana: Quick sync — I sketched a proposal for the rerank endpoint scoring envelope + tenant quota accounting. TL;DR: return a normalized score for UIs/thresholding, keep raw_score for model signals, expose model_hint, and bill per-candidate units.
Mike: Curious — normalizing to [0,1] loses rank calibration between models. Do we keep raw logits?
Ana: Yes — proposal includes raw_score preserved as raw_score and a score_type field to indicate semantics.
Zhen: Suggested shape:
```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1", "score":0.87, "raw_score":123.4},
    {"id":"c2", "score":0.12, "raw_score":17.9}
  ],
  "score_type": "probability", // or "logit" / "similarity"
  "model_hint": "reranker-v2"
}
```
Diego: Telemetry side — we need to capture both normalized and raw distributions. Add histogram tags per-model_hint and per-tenant.
Eva: For quotas: proposal for candidate-unit formula = 1 + ceil(tokens/64). So a 128-token candidate counts as 3 units (1 base + 2). That maps to cost and throttles better than flat candidate counting.
Sam: Console UX — show per-route candidate units, and an explainer tooltip showing the formula. Also show a small sample distribution chart (p50/p99 tokens per candidate) so teams can estimate spend.
Mike: Edgecases: if score_type=="similarity" we should document whether higher is better. We need a direction flag or guarantee that score is monotonically descending best->worst.
Zhen: Add a field `score_desc` with values "higher_is_better" or "lower_is_better". Default to higher_is_better for probability/similarity.
Ana: Routing model selection: default affinity rule is tenant_pref -> route_affinity -> global_fallback. We should allow customers to pin model_hint via parameter, but not bypass Dedicated SLA checks.
Eva: Billing note — pinned models on Dedicated should charge reserved capacity, not per-unit billing. Need console label to show when a pinned model triggers reserved billing.
Diego: Telemetry/Alerting — add a regression alert: if normalized score distribution shifts > 3 sigma vs baseline for a tenant, trigger eval pipeline. Keep model_hint in the alert context.
Sam: UX for rollouts: allow canary param {"model_hint": "rerank-canary", "traffic_pct": 5}. Console should surface canary traffic and outcome metrics (precision@k, latency, candidate_units).
ops-bot: Deploybot: canary rollout for rerank endpoint scheduled at 2026-04-12 22:00 UTC. Reminder: add telemetry hooks before rollout.
Ana: Back to API surface — include `explain` optional field that returns top-k feature contributions (only for debug/paid tiers). E.g. "explain": [{"id":"c1", "features":[{"f":"bm25","v":0.12}]}].
Mike: Privacy: explain should be gated behind tenant setting; no raw user text in explanations.
Zhen: Implementation note — on runtime we can compute normalized score by applying a monotonic transform per model to map to [0,1] using stored calibration params.
Eva: Console asks: default display should prefer normalized score but allow toggling raw_score for power users.
Ana: Proposal action items:
- Zhen: update OpenAPI spec with score_type, raw_score, score_desc, model_hint, explain (due EOD Tue).
- Sam: mock console panel for candidate units + canary metrics (design by Thu).
- Diego: add histogram telemetry + regression alert prototype (PR by Fri).
- Eva: doc & billing note for pinned models on Dedicated (doc PR by Wed).
- Mike: write short note about semantics for score consumers (backwards compat) and add example consumers mapping (by Thu).
Sam: I'll add the mock and ping docs team for tooltip copy.
Ana: OK — if no major objections we'll land this as a proposal and start API PRs. :thumbsup:
